## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, and `npm run package` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:integration` passes if activation, contributions, or `src/test` changed
- [ ] New behavior has a test in `src/__tests__`
- [ ] User-visible changes are listed in `CHANGELOG.md` and, if needed, `README.md`
